World Cup Final Focuses on Messi, Argentina-Spain Rivalry, and Global Fan Impact

The FIFA World Cup final between Argentina and Spain is drawing significant attention, with a focus on Lionel Messi's performance and the emotional weight of the match for fans. The event has sparked varied reactions globally, from increased heart attack cases in Argentina to local celebrations in India. Environmental concerns in New York have also raised questions about the match's feasibility.
